🔄 Content Update (Published: October 27, 2026 / Previously posted: July 22, 2026)
Main change: The alert period has been changed to October 27 – November 5, 2026. Of the 5 accidents in this alert period, 3 involved elderly victims, and 2 occurred on crosswalks during dark hours (within 1 hour after sunset or before sunrise).

Saitama Prefecture has issued a Traffic Fatal Accident Alert following 5 fatal traffic accidents that occurred between October 20 and October 23, 2026 (Reiwa 8).

【Alert Period】
October 27 – November 5, 2026 (10 days)

【Characteristics of the Accidents】
Of 5 accidents, 3 involved elderly victims. Two of these occurred on crosswalks during dark hours—within 1 hour after sunset or within 1 hour before sunrise.

【For Pedestrians】
• Use crosswalks and pedestrian overpasses
• Always look both ways and use hand signals (raising your hand, etc.) to clearly show drivers your intention to cross
• Wear reflective materials, lights, or bright-colored clothing during dusk, night, and early morning hours

【For Drivers】
• Obey speed limits and drive with caution and distance
• Pedestrians have priority at crosswalks
• About 70% of pedestrian accidents occur when crossing from the right side of the vehicle's view; pay special attention to crossings from the right
• Drive with consideration for elderly pedestrians
• Turn on headlights early at dusk, and use high beams effectively at night
• Make thorough checks when turning right or left

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/shiminseikatsubu/jinkenkurashianzen/bohan/7837.html
